chunks: Muhammad ibn Aslam, al-Tabari, al-Halabi, Abu Ja'far. His origin was Kufan. He used to do commerce to Tabaristan. A ghali, corrupt in hadith. He narrated from al-Rida (peace be upon him).

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Al-Rida (Imam Ali al-Rida, the eighth Imam)
key_terms.طَبَرِسْتَانَ: Tabaristan (a historical region in northern Iran)
key_terms.غَالٍ: Ghali (one who exaggerates in the virtues or status of the Imams)
key_terms.فَاسِدُ الْحَدِيثِ: Fasiq al-hadith (corrupt in hadith, indicating reliability issues)

ai.seo_question: Who is Muhammad ibn Aslam al-Tabari and what is his status in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This is a biographical entry from the book 'Kitab al-Du'afa' describing the narrator Muhammad ibn Aslam al-abi. It notes his Kufan origin, his trade with Tabaristan, and classifies him as 'ghali' (exaggerator) and 'fasiq al-hadith' (corrupt in hadith) who narrated from Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him).
